business_problem: CTI needed a scalable way to assess pronunciation and support Chinese language learners worldwide without relying only on human evaluators and inconsistent feedback loops.
solution_summary: Chinese Testing International Company Limited built its Learn Pronunciation to HSK application on Azure AI Speech to give Chinese language learners immediate pronunciation assessment at global scale. Learners speak into the app, Azure AI Speech analyzes pronunciation quality, and the system returns targeted feedback plus follow-on practice content that closes the loop across teaching, learning, testing, and assessment. CTI designed the application to support multiple difficulty levels and repeated practice cycles, while its broader roadmap also ties AI into facial recognition, test recognition, and intelligent assessment workflows. The architecture turns what used to require scarce expert evaluation into a consistent cloud service that can reach a worldwide learner base. For CTI, the result is a mobile pronunciation classroom that supports 1,330 test centers across 162 countries with more reliable evaluation, faster feedback, and lower demand on human grading resources.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Speech
solution_components.role: Performs pronunciation assessment and generates the immediate feedback used by learners.

solution_components.name: Learn Pronunciation to HSK
solution_components.role: Delivers the learner-facing mobile classroom, practice loop, and targeted remediation experience.

data_flow: Learner speech is captured in Learn Pronunciation to HSK, analyzed by Azure AI Speech for pronunciation quality, and then returned as targeted assessment feedback and repeated practice content that reinforces weak areas.
business_outcome: CTI expanded AI-supported Chinese language assessment globally, improving evaluation consistency and learner feedback while saving material, labor, and instructional effort.

evidence_quotes: Using Azure AI Speech Services, CTI created the Learn Pronunciation to HSK application, providing instant pronunciation feedback to learners.
The application leverages Azure AI Speech pronunciation assessment to provide instant, accurate, and targeted pronunciation assessment feedback to Chinese language learners around the world.
Presently, CTI has set up 1,330 test centers across 162 countries, catering to over 50 million Chinese learners worldwide.
